title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Role

WIA Systems Inc. is a global professional services company founded in 2016 and headquartered in Texas. Specializing in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), the company provides a range of services including consulting, implementation, training, 24x7 support, and staff augmentation. Their certified implementation team focuses on IFS ERP and employs agile project management methodologies for quality results. WIA Systems has dedicated customer support and application hosting services to assist clients in achieving their business objectives. With a presence in markets across the USA, Canada, UK, and Sri Lanka, WIA Systems is positioned as a comprehensive ERP solutions provider.

The Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and supporting enterprise networking across on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments using Zero Trust principles.

This hands-on role manages secure connectivity, network access controls, firewalls, remote access, on-premises servers, storage, and backup services. The role ensures reliable performance, limits unauthorized access and maintains tested recovery capabilities for critical business systems.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Networking

  • Design, configure, and maintain on-premises and Azure network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, wireless, routing, switching, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Manage Azure virtual networks, subnets, routing, network security groups, private endpoints, and hybrid connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity issues and maintain network diagrams, configurations, and operating procedures.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and security services, including firewall policies, VPNs, intrusion prevention, web filtering, application control, and threat protection.

Zero Trust Network Access & Segmentation

  • Implement and support Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) for secure access to business applications and infrastructure.
  • Apply least privilege access based on user identity, device compliance, and approved business requirements.
  • Implement network segmentation to isolate sensitive systems and reduce lateral movement.
  • Regularly review access rules and remove unnecessary or outdated permissions.
  • Coordinate with identity, endpoint, and security teams to maintain consistent access policies.

Firewall Management & Secure Remote Access

  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot firewalls, security policies, VPNs, and secure remote access services.
  • Review firewall rules, network traffic, and configuration changes to identify security gaps.
  • Maintain firewall firmware and configuration backups and validate changes through established change management procedures.
  • Support investigation and containment of network-related security incidents.

Network Monitoring & Performance

  • Monitor network availability, utilization, latency, and service health.
  • Investigate alerts, resolve incidents, and perform root cause analysis for recurring issues.
  • Plan capacity improvements and implement measures to improve performance and resilience.
  • Coordinate with internet providers, vendors, and support partners to resolve service disruptions.

On-Premises Server Infrastructure

  • Administer physical servers, virtualization platforms, and Windows and/or Linux server environments.
  • Perform provisioning, patching, hardening, lifecycle maintenance, and capacity management.
  • Maintain server availability and coordinate maintenance to minimize business disruption.
  • Manage administrative access in accordance with approved security standards.

Storage & Backup

  • Administer storage platforms, monitor capacity and health, and manage storage access permissions.
  • Configure and monitor backup jobs, retention policies, and protected copies appropriate to business requirements.
  • Investigate backup failures and verify that critical systems and data remain recoverable.
  • Maintain backup documentation and protect backup infrastructure from unauthorized access.

Disaster Recovery & Restore Testing

  • Maintain recovery procedures for networking, on-premises servers, storage, and backup services.
  • Execute scheduled restore and disaster recovery tests with relevant service owners.
  • Validate recovery against agreed recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs).
  • Document test results, track corrective actions, and support recovery during outages or incidents.

Operational Ownership & Collaboration

  • Own assigned incidents, service requests, problems, and changes through resolution.
  • Maintain accurate infrastructure inventories, technical documentation, and support runbooks.
  • Collaborate with IT Service Management, Infrastructure, Platforms & Security Operations, and Enterprise Architecture & Innovation.
  • Identify opportunities to automate routine work and improve security, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience configuring, administering, and troubleshooting Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and security services, including firewall policies, VPNs, intrusion prevention, web filtering, application control, and threat protection.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, networking, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands on experience in Network administration and IT infrastructure
  • Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise networks and on-premises infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure networking and hybrid connectivity.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Practical understanding of Zero Trust principles, ZTNA, network segmentation, and least-privilege access.
  • Experience administering server virtualization, storage, backup, and recovery technologies.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues, manage priorities, and communicate clearly with technical and business teams.
  • Experience following incident, problems and changing management processes.
  • Relevant networking, Azure, security, or infrastructure certifications, such as CCNA, CCNP, or Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate.
  • Experience with identity-based access controls and device compliance integrations.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, infrastructure automation, and configuration management.
  • Experience supporting disaster recovery exercises and maintaining recovery runbooks.

title: POS Customer Support Executive
description:
POS Customer Support Executive

Lanka Tech | Dehiwala | Full-time

Job Description

We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused, and technically capable POS Customer Support Executive to provide day-to-day technical support for our Point of Sale (POS) systems and related solutions.

The role involves supporting retail shops, restaurants, and other business customers by troubleshooting POS software issues, assisting with billing and operational queries, supporting hardware and peripheral configurations, and coordinating with technical and development teams to ensure timely issue resolution.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a practical approach to problem-solving, and an interest in learning POS technology, retail operations, and restaurant management systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide first-level technical support to customers using POS systems via telephone, email, WhatsApp, chat, and ticketing systems.
  • Assist customers with POS billing, product management, barcode scanning, pricing, promotions, discounts, refunds, cashiers, and shift management.
  • Troubleshoot common POS software issues, including application errors, slow performance, freezing, printing issues, and login problems.
  • Provide basic technical support for POS terminals, receipt printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, weighing scales, card payment terminals, and other connected devices.
  • Assist with restaurant POS operations, including kitchen order tickets (KOT), kitchen display systems (KDS), table management, takeaway orders, and online food delivery integrations.
  • Guide customers through software configuration, system settings, user access, product setup, and day-to-day operational procedures.
  • Perform initial checks for database connectivity, network issues, server availability, and communication between POS terminals and local servers.
  • Collect relevant information, screenshots, error messages, logs, and other diagnostic details to identify and resolve reported issues.
  • Create, categorize, prioritize, assign, and update support tickets with accurate troubleshooting and resolution details.
  • Monitor outstanding tickets, follow up with customers, and ensure issues are addressed within agreed service-level agreement (SLA) timelines.
  • Escalate complex software, database, hardware, and integration issues to the Technical Support Engineer or Development Team.
  • Coordinate with the technical team to test fixes, verify resolutions, and communicate updates to customers.
  • Assist with remote troubleshooting, software configuration, updates, and customer system checks where authorized.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, incidents, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions.
  • Prepare and maintain customer guides, FAQs, troubleshooting documentation, and internal knowledge-base articles.
  • Assist with customer onboarding, system installations, user training, and demonstrations when required.
  • Provide guidance and day-to-day assistance to Support Interns where applicable.
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly support reports covering ticket volumes, unresolved issues, recurring problems, and resolution performance.
  • Maintain professional customer relationships and contribute to continuous improvement in support quality and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in POS support, IT support, software support, customer support, or a similar technical role.
  • Basic understanding of POS billing systems, retail operations, restaurant operations, or business software.
  • Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, printers, barcode scanners, and basic computer hardware.
  • Basic understanding of networking, IP addresses, LAN connectivity, and client-server applications.
  • Familiarity with software installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and remote support tools.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL Server and database connectivity will be an added advantage.
  • Experience with retail POS systems, restaurant POS systems, KDS, payment terminals, or inventory management software will be highly advantageous.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence in handling customer support calls.
  • Ability to explain technical issues and solutions clearly to non-technical customers.
  • Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple support requests and priorities.
  • Strong attention to detail when documenting incidents, following procedures, and tracking resolutions.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical support, development, and implementation teams.
  • Customer-focused attitude, patience, accountability, and willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Willingness to provide support according to the company's assigned shifts and customer support requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting commercial POS or EPOS software in retail shops, supermarkets, convenience stores, or restaurants.
  • Experience with SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), basic SQL queries, and database backup procedures.
  • Familiarity with receipt printers, weighing scales, cash drawers, barcode scanners, and card payment integrations.
  • Experience with CRM, ticketing systems, WhatsApp customer support, or remote desktop support.
  • A diploma or certificate in IT, Computer Science, Networking, or a related field is an advantage.

What We Offer

  • Practical experience with commercial POS and retail technology solutions.
  • Opportunities to develop technical troubleshooting and software support skills.
  • Exposure to retail, restaurant, inventory, payment, and reporting systems.
  • Career development opportunities within the technical support and software solutions teams.

Location: Dehiwala, Sri Lanka

Employment Type: Full-time
